identity.description: Automotive ideal-diode controller in SOT-23-6; ANODE/CATHODE sense the series path, GATE drives the external N-MOSF, and EN must not float.

entries.evidence: Capjack promoted the six-pin exact part after an in-context ideal-diode fit pass. Hydra requalified the same symbol for two 5 V source legs: 1=VCAP, 2=GND, 3=EN, 4=CATHODE, 5=GATE, 6=ANODE; the side-oriented power path keeps ANODE/CATHODE wiring visually traceable.

promotion.fit_note: Capjack proved the exact six-pin controller; Hydra's 2026-09-01 fit pass confirmed the side-oriented ANODE/CATHODE/GATE geometry on two LM74700 + AO3400A ideal-diode legs.
promotion.note: Exact LM74700QDBVRQ1 pin map: 1 VCAP, 2 GND, 3 EN, 4 CATHODE, 5 GATE, 6 ANODE; native SOT-23-6 land.
